acceptanceCriteria: the failures are reproduced with retained loads and the watcher tolerance that cancels the context is named
the tests wait on the condition they need (no fixed wall-clock margin) and pass 20 consecutive runs at load ~60, or a product defect is filed separately
body: Residual from the V1-1465 classification (store-test lane, PR #965, 2026-10-16). One run at load 67-82 (17 min): TestCALV0078 SupervisedRunAfterCommitIsNotRetryable failed 4/5 subtests and IntegratorFailureBeforeLeavingSelectionIsRetryable 1/5, with "context canceled" in WAITING or "fault point reached 0 times". Classified load-sensitive (the product watcher's heartbeat/read tolerance), not fixed. Child case for the V1-0849 umbrella. Reproduction: `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestCALV0078_(Supervised|Integrator)' ./internal/tasks/store` under load.
title: tests: CALV0078 SupervisedRunAfterCommitIsNotRetryable and IntegratorFailureBeforeLeavingSelectionIsRetryable fail under load on the stage watcher's tolerance
